cause_quote: The split worker build added `"worker/worker-chunk-highlight": "node_modules/highlight.js/lib/index.js"`, passing an unanchored dependency path that can resolve against an enclosing checkout.
user_saw: A release operator building from a nested checkout could have validation stop before the scenario ran because the worker build selected a dependency from the enclosing checkout.
summary: The fix anchors worker dependency entries to their owning checkout, preserves available RSS observations, corrects database admission fixtures, and adds Telegram startup diagnostics.
reasoning: I based the classification on the worker build failure, which the PR documents with a focused regression test. The introducing diff added the first bare dependency entry when it split the worker bundle, a later commit added a second entry in the same form, and the manifest refactor carried both paths forward. The local history establishes when the unanchored entry shipped, but the reported failure was verified against the release baseline with a later bundler version.
